messages:
Priya: Quick sync — VoltEdge marketplace certification + joint perf/W smoke tests. Need to lock plan for throughput runs, kernel tune window, and what we can publish (exec summary) so marketplace listing isn't blocked.
Alex: I can lead the baseline runs. prefer to reuse redwood-bench-v2 so results are comparable. what sample sizes do we need?
Marco: For kernel changes we'll need a 48h freeze window on the node images. also need vendor driver builds and SHA so we can repro.
Priya: @Alex ok for bench harness. @Marco 48h freeze workable w/ partner? I'll confirm. Also need to decide power meter vs vendor telemetry — which numbers are authoritative?
Alex: Prefer independent power meters (Watts via INA232) for perf/W. vendor telemetry ok for correlation but not publishable unless partner signs data release.
Jenny: Marketplace listing folks want a short blurb + a throughput chart and a 99th-latency number. Can we commit to a publishable png?
Priya: Yes — goal: 1-page exec summary + 2 charts (throughput vs batch, perf/W curve). Marco, can you produce a 2-column CSV output we can ingest for plotting?
Marco: Yep. I'll output `throughput,latency_p50,latency_p99,power_w,config_tag` per run. Sample:  `1024,23,87,310,rv2-default`.
Nina: Heads up — any raw telemetry that identifies VoltEdge internal HW traces needs legal signoff. we need a one-off addendum to the NDA for public numbers.
Priya: Understood. I'll loop in legal. Nina, can you draft the addendum template we can send to them?
Nina: I'll put a template in the dropbox and ping VoltEdge counsel. want to see fields: permitted metrics, embargo window, quote approval.
Alex: Test matrix suggestion: sequence lengths [64,512], batch sizes [1,8,32], model shards [1,2], quant levels [fp16,int8]. Run 3 seeds each for median. That should give perf/W curve.
Priya: Good matrix. Also need a small smoke before we start heavy runs to validate image/driver. Can we schedule smoke on Tue 10:00 UTC?
BenchBot: Scheduled: `voltedge-smoke-2026-04-07-10:00Z` — job 8342 queued. Results will post to #bench-results.
Marco: I'll prepare kernel patch notes and a docker image tag `rv/voltedge-kernel-2026-04-06`. Please don't run heavy sweeps on the nodes until I publish.
Jenny: Who owns the marketplace compliance checklist? I'll slot it in content track and need final blurb by Wed EOD.
Priya: Jenny owns marketplace copy. Alex owns bench runs. Marco owns images/CSV output. Nina owns legal addendum. I'll coordinate partner comms.
Alex: Quick command we'll run for baseline (example):
```
./run_bench.sh --suite redwood-bench-v2 --model gpt-small --seq 512 --batch 8 --reps 3 --power-meter /dev/ttyUSB0 --out results/voltedge-baseline.csv
```
Priya: If partner wants to supply their own driver, we need a signed reproducibility file listing kernel version, driver SHA, and test harness checksum.
Marco: Agree — add `driver_sha` and `kernel_version` columns to CSV.
Nina: Also add `data_release_policy` field in the template: publishable yes/no/embargo_date.
Priya: Tentative timeline: smoke Tue 4/7, baseline sweep Thu-Fri 4/9-4/10, initial exec summary draft Mon 4/13, partner review Tues 4/14, public listing week of 4/20 if legal clears.
Jenny: I'll draft blurb and get a design for two charts — need CSV by Fri to generate.
Alex: I'll start the runs after smoke. ping me in thread when BenchBot posts smoke results.
BenchBot: Smoke results: PASS on small sanity checks. power meter detected, docker image pulled. Full sweep scheduled.
Priya: Great progress. Action items in-thread: Jenny (marketplace blurb) due 2026-04-10 EOD, Alex (full sweep + CSV) due 2026-04-10 EOD, Marco (image + CSV schema) due 2026-04-06 EOD, Nina (NDA addendum template) due 2026-04-05 EOD. I'll draft exec summary after partner review.
Alex: noted.
Priya: Thanks team — I'll book partner call for Wed 4/8 16:00 UTC to confirm freeze and export permissions.
Jenny: :thumbsup:
Nina: Adding legal counsel to Wed invite.
Marco: I'll attach kernel notes in the repo before Wed.
Priya: OK closing loop here. will update thread after partner call.
